items.item:
8. Erasing before today, at 00:00:00 UTC of today, keeps the erasure's own
   entry, whose instant is not before the start of that date, and removes an
   entry made a microsecond before it.
   Shows A15-2, A15-3. [witness: verification:registry_a15_erase_at_midnight_keeps_own_entry_boundary]
statements: erase(d) accepted => no entry with instant < start_of(d) remains   -- A15-2
erase(d) accepted => its erasure entry e has e.instant >= start_of(d)   -- A15-3

verdicts.item:
8. Erasing before today, at 00:00:00 UTC of today, keeps the erasure's own
   entry, whose instant is not before the start of that date, and removes an
   entry made a microsecond before it.
   Shows A15-2, A15-3. [witness: verification:registry_a15_erase_at_midnight_keeps_own_entry_boundary]
statements: erase(d) accepted => no entry with instant < start_of(d) remains   -- A15-2
erase(d) accepted => its erasure entry e has e.instant >= start_of(d)   -- A15-3
quotes: assert log[0] == before[2]  # at 00:00:00, not before it: kept
verdicts.why: The check establishes two entries before the date boundary and one exactly at it, then verifies that exactly the two earlier entries are removed and the boundary entry remains. It also identifies the erasure's own entry and verifies that its instant equals, and therefore is not before, the date's start.
